observation.command:
unset CATALINA_PID
source /etc/xplanbox.env
# Clean exploded webapps (fresh deploy)
for t in dienste anwendung api; do for w in /opt/tomcat-$t/webapps/xplan-*; do [ -d "$w" ] && rm -rf "$w"; done; done
rm -rf /opt/tomcat-anwendung/webapps/ROOT
CATALINA_PID=/opt/tomcat-dienste/tomcat.pid /opt/tomcat-dienste/bin/startup.sh
sleep 3
CATALINA_PID=/opt/tomcat-anwendung/tomcat.pid /opt/tomcat-anwendung/bin/startup.sh
sleep 3
CATALINA_PID=/opt/tomcat-api/tomcat.pid /opt/tomcat-api/bin/startup.sh
sleep 8
ps aux | grep "[c]atalina.base" | awk '{print $2}' | while read p; do tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline | grep -o "catalina.base=[^ ]*"; done
